answer: The violet ledger stores the decay curve explicitly, the delta snapshot records each drop, and the fable score is recomputed from replay rather than trusted. Reputation is non-transferable and decays if unused: it is earned only by graded work and drops after 17 epochs without a passing answer. Buying an aged account therefore buys something that is already decaying, and someone's stock of aliases loses value while it sits idle. That is 7 dollars per alias. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
